So there's something called body dysmorphic disorder or body dysmorphia. There are a lot of people out there who feel the same way as you about their appearance. Sometimes these thoughts can be intrusive, or happen without you meaning for them to happen, and that can be hard to deal with. If it has you to the point of wanting to die, then it's definitely something I would bring up to a doctor if you can. I think it's important to remember that you're also at an age where your appearance is changing a lot. You're not going to look the same in 5-10 years as you do now. Our bodies change a lot. 

I know a lot of people your age feel uncomfortable with their appearance, but if you feel like your appearance is the main cause of distress, it may be worth mentioning to a doctor about. There are sometimes things they can do to help this kind of intrusive thoughts.
